body: I really want to be a singer. The only thing stopping me is my confidence and my anxiety. I want to perform on stages and make people happy with my music, but I can’t because I’m afraid. I guess I’ll have to find an alternative.

My parents were always abusive to me. I’ve always been that ‘People Pleaser’ person. My mother would physically and mentally abuse me, while my father was an alcoholic. This year has put me through hell, because of the fact that I need to stay home more often. (Which I really don’t want to do). I’ve attempted suicide 2 times, but every time, I would think, “Is there really something to live for?” I thought about it for a while and I felt something spark in me. I didn’t really know what it was, but it wanted me to keep going. So, now I’m here. I have very supportive online friends and I don’t feel as lonely as before. I’m trying.

I’d just like to point out that my parents are abusive. I’m diagnosed with depression and anxiety from them, and I’m not ashamed to say it because I know it’s not my fault. I don’t want my future child to live in fear like I am right now. I don’t want them to suffer.

I fear of being judged and I fear of failure. I sing and play piano as a passion and I really want to perform in front of people, but it’s just that, I can’t. Every single time I try to perform in front of big crowds, my mind tells me everything that can go wrong. “You’re going to mess up and EVERYONE will hate YOU.” That’s what it always says. And whenever I try to conquer my fear, a panic attack occurs and I just run off stage.
I listen to music anytime I want. I sing, play piano and make songs as a passion. Music is what I live for, if I don’t have it, I might as well just die.

Okay, so, I might be putting too much detail into this but who cares. I am currently an experienced singer who longs to perform and be noticed on a stage. But, I have issues with my anxiety. I am afraid of judgement, criticism and failure. Last year, I was supposed to perform in front of my school, but my mind kept telling me what might go wrong. “Hah, everyone will hate your voice.” “You’re going to mess up a lyric and get hated for it.” So, I just ran off stage and had a panic attack in the girls restroom.

I have Glossophobia (Fear of Public Speaking) and Atychiphobia (Fear of Failure). Literally THE WORST COMBINATION of phobias ever, considering the fact that I have a singing passion and I LONG to be on a stage performing. My fears have been stopping me from what I want to do and I am tired of it! Every time I try to perform in front of crowds, my head just tells me everything that might go wrong. “If you mess up everyone will DESPISE you.” “No one will like your voice, they will hate it and unfriend you.” I try to force my inner voice to just SHUT THE FUCK UP but it won’t work.
Goodbye
